question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.9.**
solution:
The correct answer is "**​****vitals**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The **theme **of the passage is the **moral degradation **of Indian society over a period of time(from ancient times to the contemporary period).
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the words
 
• **vitals: **the body's important internal organs.
 
• **threats: **a statement of an intention to inflict pain, injury, damage, or other hostile action on someone in retribution for something done or not done.
 
• **imperative: **of vital importance; crucial.
 
• **necessity: **the pressure of circumstance
 
 
• **Example**: *The nurse checked the patient's **vitals **__before he was taken for surgery.*
 
 

**The complete passage is:-** *In ancient times, Hieun Tsang, a Chinese traveller came to India during the **(1)reign** of KingHarsha. He praised the Indians **(2)as** ‘people with pure moral principles’. In 2014, India **(3)ranked** 85th in the corruption perception index of the Transparency International. What **(4)a** downfall! Isn’t it ironical that we Indians **(5)swear** by the ideals of honesty and integrity, self-denial and **(6)sacrifice** but in practice willingly resort to the **(7) vilest** forms of corruption to promote our interests? The **(8)malaise **of corruption is eating into the **(9) vitals** of our society and we have become helpless **(10) onlookers **of our own degradation.*
